section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1995
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 1995 N.C.R.B.(M.H.A.) 1.3.4.3 Additional information on number of 'Rail-Road Accidents' alongwith 'Other-Railway Accidents' and people killed and injured was collected this year. In all 2,31,851 'Traffic Accident' cases comprising of 2,14,397, 'Road Accidents', 2747 'Rail-Road Accidents' & 14,707 'Other Railway Accidents' were reported during 1995. The 'Rail-Road Accidents' and 'Other Railway Accidents' rendered 349 & 4187 persons injured respectively. The number of persons killed in such accidents were 3568 and 12884 respectively.
